parsed.note_claim: Walmart is not closing its doors; the claim that it is closing is fake news.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In short, Walmart did not announce it planned to close stores and lock their doors on Nov. 1. Walmart spokesperson Joe Pennington told Snopes by phone that the chain will be open for business on that date.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that Walmart is not closing its doors and that the rumor is false, substantiating the note's claim.
